name: blueprint/citation-trail
description: Every claim carries its source: rh_text_extract pulls claim+citation triples from the working text, the store keeps the trail, and the agent asserts only what the trail supports.
use_cases: audit which claim came from where
ingredients: rh_text_extract with a claim schema { claim, source, quote }
the agent asserts only trailed claims
recipe: working text -> extract { claim, source, quote } triples -> store one record per triple -> compose the answer from trailed claims only -> a claim without a record is flagged, not asserted
result_kind: one store record per claim + a source list per answer
pitfalls: the quote is the check - a cite without a quote is unfalsifiable
extract fails clean on malformed input - never assert on a partial parse
the trail is per answer, not global - store it beside the answer
